page.title: Now
page.purpose: Answer in five seconds whether anything needs the operator and whether anything is working: one status line with the newest research write, the needs-you titles, then live, limited and paused supervisors with their topics; what changed in a chosen period with one Caught up; overlaps among commissions open now.

states.description: One status line (live, paused and limited counts and the newest research write); at most three needs-you titles with the count, each opening its item; a group each for live, limited and paused with claims shown apart from observations and an allowance-ended badge; Since with a period choice and a confirmed Caught up; overlapping pairs among open commissions; prepared packets; every state count.
Each section announces that it is reading the research home.
No supervisor window is open: the page says so and offers Launch. With windows open but nothing live, a notice says nothing is working and the paused or limited groups follow.
An optional scenario is down or a research-home file cannot be read; only the values it feeds read unknown with the reason, and a notice names the scenario or lists the files.
The API cannot be reached or refused the read; the page names which and offers retry, and nothing else on the page pretends to know.
A refresh failed after a good read: the earlier read stays on screen under a 'Not current' notice with its time and the reason.
